messages.subject: Project Skylark - signing checklist and timetable
messages.plaintextBody:
Robert, Grace,

Attached is the signing checklist. Caldera's board passed its written resolutions today, Halstead approved yesterday, and the agreed form is locked. We'll circulate the execution version PDF tomorrow (14 Nov) for signature. The £4.5m upfront falls due within 10 business days of the Effective Date.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
